CAREERS​​​

QatarEnergy LNG offers prospective employees a unique opportunity to be involved in making history happen. There are a wide variety of roles available in both the development projects as well as the permanent operating organisation.

Together with our shareholder partners, QatarEnergy LNG operates 14 liquefied natural gas (LNG) trains including six mega trains that are the largest to ever be built.  The current total production capacity of QatarEnergy LNG is 77 million tonnes of LNG per annum - the largest in the world.  In addition, QatarEnergy LNG operates a condensate refinery - Laffan Refinery.​​​​

FRAUDULENT RECRUITMENT

Beware of criminals offering fictitious employment with QatarEnergy LNG. They will ask for fees for visas, administrative fees, and similar. We never ask anyone who applies to work at QatarEnergy LNG to make any payment. If someone asks you for money as part of an application process or you suspect the person you are dealing with is fraudulent or untruthful – please contact us straight away by reporting any suspected recruitment-related fraud by 

REPORT FRAUD

Below are some tell-tale signs that you may have been approached by a criminal offering fictitious employment:​​

  • Offers of employment without being invited for interview.
  • Being asked to pay a fee as part of the recruitment process.
  • Being offered a position you did not apply for.
  • Use of a webmail email address – not a QatarEnergy LNG email address.
  • Spelling mistakes and poor grammar.
  • Pressuring you by making the recruitment seem urgent.​

Please note that all correspondence by email from QatarEnergy LNG is from the email domain _______@qatarenergylng.qa. If you receive an email without this as the address, it may not be an authentic communication from the QatarEnergy LNG Recruitment Section. If you have any doubts as to the authenticity of an email, please contact us.

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. We use the following session cookies, which are all required to enable the website to function:
  • "route" is used for session stickiness
  • "careerSiteCompanyId" is used to send the request to the correct data centre
  • "JSESSIONID" is placed on the visitor's device during the session so the server can identify the visitor
  • "Load balancer cookie" (actual cookie name may vary) prevents a visitor from bouncing from one instance to another
